# app-publish-mcp

> MCP server for App Store Connect & Google Play Console — manage app listings, screenshots, releases, reviews & submissions from AI assistants

## Install

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "app-publish-mcp": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "app-publish-mcp"],
      "env": {
        "APPLE_KEY_ID": "YOUR_KEY_ID",
        "APPLE_KEY_TYPE": "TEAM",
        "APPLE_ISSUER_ID": "YOUR_ISSUER_ID",
        "APPLE_P8_PATH": "/path/to/AuthKey.p8",
        "GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH": "/path/to/service-account.json"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Required | Description |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| `APPLE_KEY_ID` | For iOS | App Store Connect API Key ID |
| `APPLE_KEY_TYPE` | For iOS | `TEAM` (default) or `INDIVIDUAL` |
| `APPLE_ISSUER_ID` | Team keys | App Store Connect Issuer ID |
| `APPLE_P8_PATH` | For iOS | Path to AuthKey .p8 file |
| `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH` | Android option 1 | Path to Google service account JSON |
| `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` | Android option 2 | Google Desktop OAuth client ID |
| `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` | Android option 2 | Google Desktop OAuth client secret |
| `GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN` | Android option 2 | Google OAuth refresh token |
